name: Garlic Croutons II
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 cup ½-inches bread cubes from good-quality French or Italian loaf

steps: Warm an 8-inch skillet over low heat while preparing bread. A minute before you are ready to cook, turn heat up to medium.
Toss bread in a bowl with oil, salt, and garlic powder.
Cook, stirring often, until crisp and golden brown (about 7 minutes).
Use as a garnish for soups and salads.
